## 3. Chuyên môn Cốt lõi (Core Engineering Competencies)
1. **Kiến trúc Hệ thống Phân tán & Cloud-Native:** Microservices, High-Availability System Design, Event-Driven Architecture, Docker, Nginx, Linux Kernel Tuning, Zero-Trust Security.
2. **Fullstack & Backend Hiệu năng cao:** Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, Go, Python, React 19, Vue 3, Vite, Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Progressive Web Apps (PWA).
3. **Cơ sở dữ liệu & Dữ liệu lớn:** PostgreSQL, PostGIS (Spatial Indexing & Distributed GIS), SQLite WAL High-Concurrency, Redis Cluster, BullMQ.
4. **Trí tuệ Nhân tạo & Tự động hóa (AI Engineering):** Multi-Agent Systems, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), MCP (Model Context Protocol).
